sn_aia_trigger_agent_usecase_m2m.objective_template:
When the Student Count of a Food Base Problem is updated, reanalyze the same Food Base Problem using the current Use Case and updated Student Count.
Retrieve the Food Base Problem using its Number ${number}. Recalculate the Priority using the configured campus food-service priority rules based on the current Use Case and Student Count. Generate the updated priority reason and complete the latest AI analysis, including problem type, knowledge insights, recommended action, and related Knowledge articles. Update the same Food Base Problem record with the newly generated results.
